completedWork: src/config.js: loadConfig/ConfigError per C6.1 with the reference checkBaseUrl and isLoopbackHost logic; result frozen; warnings in table order. src/ticket-input.js: pure validateTicketInput for C3 rows 2-5 (plain-object check, own 'ticket' string, trimmed 1-8000 UTF-16 units) with C5 messages. src/log.js: createLogger with per-event allowlists (request/listening/warning/error), value type checks, method->OTHER and route->other mapping, unknown event names throw TypeError. src/http-server.js: http.createServer({requireHostHeader:false}); Host allowlist from the actual listening port at request time; Origin check for non-GET/HEAD; exact route match after stripping the query; 405 with Allow; Connection: close + req.resume() on every pre-body rejection (403/404/405/413/415); 415 then Content-Length 413 then byte-counted streaming 413 at 16384; invalid_json for empty/unparseable body; C5 fixed messages; security headers on every response; static files read once from staticDir (default public/); health from config (mode live iff apiKey); service errors -> 500 internal_error + error event (name only); one request log line per request. remainingIssues: Interpretation (spec silent): the C3 row 'empty body or JSON.parse throws -> invalid_json' is decided in http-server.js, because the C6.4 signature validateTicketInput(parsedBody) receives an already-parsed value; ticket-input.js covers rows 2-5.
Interpretation (spec silent on order): 415 is checked before the Content-Length 413 fast path; both precede any body read.

Interpretation: only an unset variable takes its default. An empty HOST, PORT, ANTHROPIC_MODEL, TRIAGE_TIMEOUT_MS or TRIAGE_MAX_TOKENS is a ConfigError. Empty ANTHROPIC_API_KEY means null and empty TRIAGE_ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL means default, as C6.1 states. TRIAGE_ALLOW_REMOTE is matched exactly (' 1' is rejected). t16 README may want to mention that 'PORT=' in .env is an error.
Origin is compared exactly (case-sensitive) to 'http://' + allowlisted value; Host is lower-cased as C1 says.
createServer throws at construction if index.html, app.js or styles.css is missing from staticDir (fail fast). t13 app.test.js and t14/t15 therefore need public/ from t07 or must pass staticDir.

Requests that Node's HTTP parser rejects before the handler runs (malformed request line, invalid Content-Length, oversized headers) get Node's default 400 without the C1 security headers. C5 has no code for them; not handled.
A client that aborts mid-body gets no response; the request log line has status null (probe ev:ev-muyozl1r-0101ef18).

For t13 (server.js): call log.event('listening', {host, port, mode, model, timeoutMs, maxTokens, baseUrlCustom}) then log.event('warning', {code}) per config.warnings; log.js drops any other field. createServer's log defaults to createLogger() when omitted.
